{{Quote|You can start with ''this'' thing I found near the crystal mines.|Jost Ellon, to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in reference to his Ranger X-1|<ref name="The Destroyer" />}}
The '''[[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]]''' were a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]] whose pioneers protected themselves with a [[Ranger X-One defense robot|Ranger X-1]]<ref name="The Destroyer" /> [[Bodyguard droid/Legends|defense droid]],<ref name="The Droids Re-Animated, Part 1">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> which [[Jost Ellon]] later found inert near the mines.<ref name="The Destroyer" />

==Behind the scenes==
The large crystal mines were first mentioned in [[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]], the first issue of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars Droids'']] comic series published by [[Star Comics]], an imprint of [[Marvel Comics]],<ref name="The Destroyer" /> which was first published on [[April 1]], [[1986]].<ref name="The Destroyer publication date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54151/star_wars_droids_1986_1|text=Star Wars: Droids (1986) #1}}</ref>
